name: camayoc_overdue_directive_traceability
description: Untraced directives whose explicit typed traceability evaluation deadline is due. ROOT plus the configured declared plane only; typed WorkItem+Policy links satisfy tracing. 101 rows is a sentinel: consumers must report incomplete if more than100. Read-time view, not permission to act.
template: PREFIX a: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> PREFIX q: <https://w3id.org/intigraph/quechua/ns#> PREFIX old: <https://scbrown.github.io/quechua/ns#> PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT DISTINCT ?directive ?label ?due FROM <urn:quipu:graph:root> FROM <{declared}> WHERE { ?directive (q:traceabilityDueAt|old:traceabilityDueAt) ?due ; a a:Directive . FILTER(DATATYPE(?due) = xsd:dateTime) FILTER(?due <= "{now}"^^xsd:dateTime) FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?directive a a:Policy } FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?directive a a:AlertRule } FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?directive a:trackedBy ?work ; a:governedBy ?policy . ?work a a:WorkItem . ?policy a a:Policy } OPTIONAL { ?directive rdfs:label ?label } } ORDER BY ?due ?directive LIMIT 101

params.name: declared
params.description: Configured trusted declared plane; never substitute inferred evidence.

params.name: now
params.description: Evaluation instant, ISO8601 xsd:dateTime with timezone.
